target_customer: Corporates, investors and insurers buying voluntary carbon credits and CORSIA units
problem: Buyers struggle to source, vet and contract quality carbon credits. Abatable runs procurement, due diligence and portfolio management.
business_model: Procurement and advisory services plus credit sourcing via the Ecosphere+ acquisition

founders.name: Maria Eugenia Filmanovic
founders.background_notes: YC page: Vice President at Goldman Sachs advising institutions on nature-based carbon removal.

founders.name: Valerio Magliulo
founders.background_notes: YC page: early Monzo employee, Techstars and Seedcamp mentor.

competitors.name: Pachama
competitors.what: Forest carbon marketplace with satellite verification
competitors.traction_then: Own offset marketplace noted as an edge over API players

competitors.name: Patch
competitors.what: API to buy carbon offsets and removal

technical_complexity.rationale: Procurement workflow, RFP automation and credit quality assessment were largely software plus domain expertise. The hard part was credit vetting knowledge and market access, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Project quality assessments and market intelligence can build data over time, and relationships matter, but advisory style procurement is replicable by other carbon firms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors moved into procurement too: Patch repositioned to enterprise procurement in April 2025 per a secondary source. Pachama was reportedly bought by Carbon Direct (unverified aggregator summary). Abatable instead acquired a supplier, Ecosphere+, in 2023.

market_need_then: Corporate net zero pledges and growing voluntary carbon market demand in 2021 created buyers who lacked procurement expertise; the founders came from carbon advisory, per the YC page.

branding.domain_note: Uses abatable.com, an exact-match .com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and partnership focused, British spelling, emphasizes independence and conflict-free advice (company site).

branding.community_and_virality: Won Environmental Finance Voluntary Carbon Market Rankings Best market innovation in 2025 and is B Corp certified, per its site. No fan or meme evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Name echoes abatement and is distinctive, and the brand is credible with institutional buyers, but no press on the brand itself and no virality evidence.

pivots.to: Added credit supply by acquiring Ecosphere+
pivots.why: Announced with the capital raise to broaden the portfolio it can offer, per the company press release

outcome_analysis: Abatable stayed independent and raised a reported 13.5 million dollar round from Azora in April 2023 while buying supplier Ecosphere+, then positioned itself as an operating system for environmental markets. Founder background in carbon advisory and a corporate net zero tailwind helped, while the carbon credit sector has seen consolidation and layoffs at peers, so durability is still unproven.
notes: The $13.5M round was reported by ESG Today, CarbonCredits.com and the company press release. Label varies: aggregators call it Series A, CB Insights calls it Seed II. Aggregator totals ($16.63M) imply an earlier seed that is not verified. A ZoomInfo $135M figure is a decimal error. Education of founders not found.
